title: One Fish Two Fish | KEY.co
description_expanded: Perched along the tranquil shores of Big Redfish Lake with glimpses of the Gulf, this extraordinary waterfront retreat offers a rare blend of coastal elegance and lakeside serenity in the heart of Blue Mountain Beach. Spanning three stories and over 6,400 square feet, the home is designed for unforgettable gatherings, comfortably accommodating up to 24 guests across eight beautifully appointed bedrooms with private en-suite bathrooms. Expansive living areas, soaring ceilings, and refined coastal interiors create an atmosphere of relaxed luxury, while the chef’s kitchen—complete with dual marble islands, Wolf and Sub-Zero appliances, and generous dining space—serves as the centerpiece for shared meals and celebrations. Multiple lounge areas, a wet bar, elevator access, and thoughtfully designed gathering spaces ensure both comfort and convenience throughout every level. Outdoor living is equally impressive, with sweeping lake views, a private dock, and a resort-style heated pool that overlooks the peaceful waters of the rare coastal dune lake. Covered porches and balconies invite guests to unwind, while the summer kitchen and alfresco dining spaces set the stage for sunset dinners and relaxed evenings under the coastal sky. Just a short stroll from the sugar-white sands of 30A, the home also includes a six-seater golf cart and six adult bikes for easy exploration of nearby beaches, restaurants, and boutique shops. Whether paddling from the dock to the Gulf, relaxing poolside, or enjoying the vibrant charm of the surrounding community, this remarkable property offers an elevated beach getaway where luxury and nature meet effortlessly.
